blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Continual learning (CL) enables neural networks to adapt to non-stationary data streams by mitigating catastrophic forgetting, offering a path to robust, private, and adaptable edge devices. Yet, porting CL to real-world edge devices remains challenging for two reasons: (i) online operation, where sensor data arrives one sample at a time and the device must adapt on-the-fly, and (ii) the low footprint of edge devices, which makes traditional error backpropagation training prohibitive. Inspired by the brain's wake and sleep cycles, the former for rapid adaptation with minimal resources and the latter for long-term consolidation, we introduce Hypnos, an open-source dual-phase platform for efficient CL at the edge. In the wake phase (e.g., daily operation), Hypnos relies on a low-footprint system-on-chip with a RISC-V microcontroller unit (MCU) targeting efficient inference and supporting lightweight gradient-free prototype updates. In the sleep phase (e.g., night-time charging), where wall-plug energy and larger memory budgets are available, a smart charger performs rehearsal-based gradient updates for consolidation. Deployed on a ZCU104 field-programmable gate array (FPGA) and synthesized in a 28-nm process, Hypnos is benchmarked on the CORe50 NICv2-391 protocol. It sets a new state-of-the-art accuracy of 78.6%-81.6% for edge CL systems, with an on-device latency of 7.79s-10.54s per sample depending on activation precision, and requires $3.8\times$ fewer learning steps and $22\times$ less learning compute than quantized latent replay at higher accuracy and comparable latency.
blocks.zh: 持续学习(CL)使神经网络能够适应非固定数据流,减缓灾难性的遗忘,提供一条通往坚固、私有和可适应的边缘设备的道路。 然而,将CL移植到现实世界边缘设备仍然具有挑战性,原因有二:(一) 在线操作,传感器数据一次到达一个样本,设备必须进行飞行调整;以及(二) 边缘设备的足迹低,这使得传统的误差反向传播训练令人望而却步. 受大脑的觉醒和睡眠周期的启发,前者是用最少的资源快速适应,后者是长期整合,我们引入了Hypnos,一个开源双相平台,用于在边缘高效的CL. 在后期(如日常操作),希普诺斯依靠一个带有RISC-V微控制器单元(MCU)的低脚印系统对芯片,瞄准高效推论,并支持轻量级梯度无原型更新. 在睡眠阶段(如夜间充电),在有墙插能量和较大内存预算的情况下,一个智能充电器会进行基于排练的梯度更新以进行整合. Hypnos在ZCU104可实地编程门阵列(FPGA)上部署,并在28nm的工艺中合成,Hypnos以CORe50 NICv2-391协议作为基准. 它为边缘CL系统设定了78.6%-81.6%的全新精度,视激活精度而定,每个样本的机床间隙为7.79s-10.54s,需要3.8\时间的学习步骤减少,22\时间的学习计算比在更高的精度和可比较的空闲度下量化的潜在重播要少.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Battery-operated devices are becoming widespread, from wearable sensors that detect the onset of a health condition to smartwatches that learn their user’s habits [ 1 , 2 ] .
These devices typically follow a train-then-deploy scenario: a model is trained once, offline, on centrally collected data, and then deployed to the user device (Fig. 1 (a), top).
Real-world deployments, however, can deviate from training conditions, as data distributions drift over time and devices can face environments and user
requirements unknown at training time [ 3 ] .
Restoring accuracy by retraining in the cloud scales poorly to real-time needs: the energy and latency footprint of wireless communication for sending data and receiving an update [ 2 ] offsets the footprints of executing instructions locally [ 4 , 5 ] .
blocks.zh:
电池操作的装置越来越普遍,从可穿戴的检测健康状况的传感器到了解用户习惯的智能表[1,2]。
这些设备一般遵循当时的列车部署情景:一个模型在集中收集的数据上被一次下线训练,然后被部署到用户设备(图1(a),顶部).
但是,现实世界的部署可能偏离培训条件,因为数据分布随时间推移而变化,设备可能面临环境和用户
培训时间不详的要求。
通过云尺度的再培训恢复准确性,使其不适应实时需求:用于发送数据和接收更新的无线通信的能量和耐用足迹[2]抵消了当地执行指令的足迹[4,5].

blocks.en: Fig. 1: (a) Performance/availability view of continual adaptation at the edge. Top: offline adaptation, where consolidation is offloaded to the cloud and the device is unavailable (shaded) whenever new data must be learned. Middle: fully on-device learning keeps the device available with online adaptation, at the cost of increased catastrophic forgetting. Bottom: proposed hybrid scheme, lightweight on-device learning during daily use (wake) with consolidation on the smart charger (sleep), combining the availability of online methods with offline-like accuracy. (b) Proposed device–charger system realizing hybrid adaptation, combining (i) a low-footprint edge device for online adaptation with (ii) a smart charger augmented with additional compute and memory budgets for offline consolidation.

blocks.en:
In contrast, on-device learning aims to remove this dependency by updating the model locally [ 6 , 7 ] .
However, efficient on-device learning is challenging as power and area budgets typical of edge devices, on the order of a few milliwatts and millimeters squared, severely cap on-device memory budgets [ 8 , 6 , 7 ] .
Furthermore, representative edge scenarios typically rely on sensor data arriving online as a non-stationary stream, violating the independent and identically distributed (iid) assumption.
Yet, online learning from a stream of non-iid data is known to erase previously acquired knowledge (Fig. 1 (a), middle), leading to catastrophic forgetting [ 9 , 10 ] .
Adapting to such streams is the goal of continual learning (CL) algorithms, which must mitigate catastrophic forgetting to do so.
Among them, rehearsal-based methods have been shown to scale best by replaying past data to emulate the iid assumption [ 11 , 12 ] .
However, replay-based CL requires large memory budgets to store past data, as well as support for error backpropagation, thereby directly conflicting with edge requirements.
blocks.zh:
相反,在线学习旨在通过在当地更新模型[6,7]来消除这种依赖。
然而,高效的安装设备学习具有挑战性,因为典型的边缘设备的动力和地区预算,大约是几毫瓦和毫米平方,严重限制安装设备的存储预算[8、6、7]。
此外,具有代表性的边缘情景通常依赖作为非固定流在线传送的传感器数据,违反了独立和相同分布的(二d)假设。
然而,人们知道,从非二元数据流中在线学习会抹去以前获得的知识(图1(a),中间),导致灾难性的忘记[9,10]。
适应这些流是持续学习算法的目标,它必须减轻忘记这样做的灾难性后果。
其中,基于排练的方法通过重播过去的数据来模拟 iid 假设[11,12] 来显示最佳规模.
然而,基于重播的CL需要大量的内存预算来存储过去的数据,以及支持错误的反向传播,从而直接与边缘要求冲突.

blocks.en:
To resolve this conflict and make the best of offline and online methods, we build on the following observation: tight energy and area constraints at the edge only apply during the daily battery-operated phase of the device.
Indeed, edge devices typically have to be put to charge on a regular basis, a process during which limits induced by battery operation can be lifted by accessing a wall plug instead.
Therefore, we propose to tackle this challenge at the system level, with a low-footprint edge device embedding cheap online adaptation complemented by a smart charger for memory- and compute-intensive offline consolidation (Figs. 1 (a), bottom, and 1 (b)).
This hybrid adaptation approach is akin to the brain’s alternating wake and sleep phases, a promising strategy in CL [ 13 , 14 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
为了解决这场冲突,并优化离线和在线方法,我们基于以下观察:在设备的日常电池操作阶段,边缘的紧张能量和面积限制才适用。
实际上,边缘装置通常必须定期充电,在这种过程中,电池操作引起的限制可以通过进入墙壁插头来解除。
因此,我们提议在系统一级应对这一挑战,采用低脚印边缘装置嵌入廉价的在线适应,辅之以一个智能充值器,用于内存和计算密集型离线合并(图1(a)、底部和1(b))。
这种混合适应方法类似于大脑交替的醒觉和睡眠阶段,这是CL[13,14,2]中充满希望的战略.

blocks.en:
In this work, we introduce Hypnos , a dual-phase system for efficient yet scalable on-device CL, co-designed based on the SIESTA algorithm [ 13 ] that introduces the use of cheap gradient-free adaptation (wake phase), which we link to daily user operation, combined with replay-based consolidation (sleep phase), which we link to the device being put to charge. Hypnos consists of • an open-source system-on-chip (SoC) targeting efficient inference at the edge, built on an X-HEEP RISC-V microcontroller unit (MCU) [ 15 ] with the Quadrilatero matrix co-processor [ 16 ] , augmented with a compact precision-scalable wake-phase accelerator for the depth-wise convolutions, requantization, and prototype operations of online learning, accounting for 10.7% of the device area, • a smart charger with a 5.5-MB memory budget for replay-based consolidation and software-based support for error backpropagation. On the CORe50 [ 17 ] NICv2-391 protocol, a full field-programmable gate array (FPGA) demonstration of Hypnos reaches an accuracy of 78.6 % at an on-device latency of 7.79 s per sample, 3.4 pp above the best prior edge CL system at comparable latency [ 6 ] , while learning fully online and on-device. A variant with INT16 activations trades latency for accuracy, reaching 81.6 % at 10.54 s per sample. Hypnos requires 3.8× fewer learning steps and 22× less learning compute than quantized latent replay at higher accuracy.
Synthesis in a 28-nm node shows that the complete edge device occupies 9.43 mm 2 and consumes 33.3 mW at 375 MHz, with the wake-phase accelerator accounting for only 10.7 % of the area. The Hypnos system is available in open source at https://github.com/cogsys-tudelft/hypnos .

blocks.en:
The remainder of this paper is structured as follows.
Section II provides background on CL and its edge deployments, as well as low-footprint techniques.
Section III introduces our framework for dual-phase CL systems.
Section IV describes the implementation of the framework through system co-design across the algorithm, the wake-phase accelerator, and the smart charger.
Finally, Section V evaluates Hypnos based on FPGA and synthesis results, an accelerator ablation, and a comparison with the state of the art on CORe50, while Section VI concludes the paper.

blocks.en: II Background
blocks.zh: 二. 背景情况

blocks.en:
In this section, we formally define CL and outline its taxonomy.
We then elaborate on the low-footprint ingredients underpinning dual-phase algorithms: prototype-based learning, latent replay, quantization, and compression. Finally, we review the hardware platforms that demonstrate them at the edge, closing on the gap this work addresses.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们正式定义CL,并概述其分类学.
然后我们阐述两相算法背后的低脚印成分:基于原型的学习、潜在的重播、量化和压缩。 最后,我们检视那些在边缘展示它们的硬件平台, 缩小这个工作地址的缺口。

blocks.en: II-A Continual Learning (CL)
blocks.zh: II-A 继续学习

blocks.en:
Deep learning assumes that data comes from a stationary distribution and is fully available at training time [ 18 , 19 ] , but real-world data streams violate both assumptions.
Formally, the environment is modeled as an ordered sequence of tasks 𝒯 = ( T 1 , T 2 , … , T N ) \mathcal{T}=(T_{1},T_{2},\dots,T_{N}) , where each task T i T_{i} presents input–label pairs ( x , y ) (x,y) drawn from their own distribution.
In the class-incremental learning (CIL) scenarios considered in this work, label sets are additionally disjoint across tasks, i.e. , 𝒴 i ∩ 𝒴 j = ∅ \mathcal{Y}_{i}\cap\mathcal{Y}_{j}=\emptyset for i ≠ j i\neq j [ 11 ] .
Continual learning is the problem of optimizing a single set of model parameters θ \theta over this sequence such that performance on earlier tasks is preserved.
Naively training θ \theta on T i + 1 T_{i+1} erases what was learned on T i T_{i} , a behavior called catastrophic forgetting shown at various degrees in Fig. 1 (a).
Among the standard CL scenarios [ 11 ] , this work targets online CIL [ 12 ] , representative of edge scenarios, which adds two constraints: (i) samples arrive in a single-pass stream and are processed once, with no multi-epoch training; and (ii) task identities are hidden at inference, so the model must discriminate among all classes seen so far.

blocks.en:
Existing CL algorithms fall into three main categories [ 11 ] , which differ not only in how they mitigate catastrophic forgetting but also in how amenable they are to low-footprint execution.
First, architectural approaches expand the network’s capacity to accommodate new knowledge [ 20 , 21 , 22 , 23 ] .
Second, regularization approaches constrain parameter updates based on parameter importance [ 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 ] or orthogonal gradient projections [ 30 , 31 ] .
Lastly, rehearsal approaches retain a subset of past samples in a memory buffer and revisit them during training [ 32 , 33 , 34 , 35 ] .
Among these, rehearsal has proven the most robust and scalable [ 11 ] , owing to its ability to emulate an iid data stream, at the expense of additional compute for every replayed sample and a memory buffer that grows with the number of retained classes.
These memory accesses, which are commonly off-chip, cost orders of magnitude more energy than the compute [ 8 ] , increasing not only latency but also power consumption.

首先,建筑方法扩大了网络容纳新知识的能力[20、21、22、23]。
第二,规范化方法限制基于参数重要性[24、25、26、27、28、29]或正向梯度预测[30、31]的参数更新。
最后,排练方法保留了记忆缓冲部分过去的样本,并在训练期间重新审视这些样本[32、33、34、35]。
其中,排练被证明是最有力和可扩展的 [11] ,因为它能够模拟一个 vid 数据流,而牺牲了每个重播样本的额外计算,以及随着保留类数的增长的内存缓冲.
这些内存访问器,通常为离芯片,成本级的能量比计算机[8]要多,不仅增加了耐久性,而且增加了功耗.

blocks.en: II-B Key Techniques for Low-Footprint CL
blocks.zh: 低排印CL的关键技术

blocks.en: In this subsection, we highlight several key techniques that have been used toward low-footprint CL and edge deployment, the ingredients from which dual-phase algorithms are composed.

blocks.en:
Even in latent form, the replay buffer dominates the memory footprint of rehearsal.
Linear quantization of the stored activations reduces it by only a few times, a gain that varies widely with the benchmark and the replay layer: on CORe50, the quantized latent replay buffer of [ 6 ] still occupies 3 to 98 MB depending on the replay layer, one to two orders of magnitude beyond the on-chip memory of an MCU.
This calls for compression techniques. Product quantization (PQ) [ 40 ] is a technique from approximate nearest-neighbor search and database storage [ 41 ] .
A feature vector 𝐳 ∈ ℝ C \mathbf{z}\in\mathbb{R}^{C} is divided into S S disjoint sub-vectors [ 𝐳 1 , … , 𝐳 S ] [\mathbf{z}_{1},\dots,\mathbf{z}_{S}] of dimension D = C / S D=C/S (Fig. 4 (a)), and each subspace m m is quantized independently by a codebook of 2 k 2^{k} centroids { 𝐬 m ( j ) } j = 1 2 k \{\mathbf{s}_{m}^{(j)}\}_{j=1}^{2^{k}} , indexed by j j and learned offline with the k-means algorithm.
A sample is encoded by storing, for each subspace, only the index of its nearest centroid, as summarized in Algorithm 1 .
Decoding corresponds to a table lookup that reconstructs each sub-vector from its centroid (Fig. 4 (b)).

blocks.en: II-C CL Deployment on Edge Hardware
blocks.zh: II-C CL 在边缘硬件上的部署

blocks.en: Each of the preceding ingredients has been demonstrated at the edge, in hardware, or as algorithms designed under edge constraints. This subsection reviews these demonstrations, which together highlight the gap this work addresses.
blocks.zh: 前面的每个成分在边缘,硬件中,或者作为在边缘限制下设计的算法都得到了证明. 本小节回顾了这些示范活动,这些示范活动共同突出了这项工作所弥补的差距。

blocks.en:
The prototype-based classifier, in the affine form of Eq. ( 3 ), was demonstrated in hardware by the Chameleon accelerator [ 7 ] , which learns the 1623 handwritten character classes of Omniglot [ 42 ] online and fully on-chip.
Latent replay was demonstrated on-device by the quantized latent replay platform (QLR-CL) of [ 6 ] , built on the VegaSoC [ 43 ] MCU, the first to solve CORe50 on-device by quantizing the latent replay buffer.
Aggarwal et al. [ 44 ] augment it with a dual-memory system operating at two learning time scales, a fast adaptive memory and a slow consolidating one, deployed on both an FPGA and an embedded graphics processing unit (GPU).
Both memories, however, are consolidated by gradient-based replay on the device itself, so the device must host error backpropagation and the full replay buffer at all times, with computational and memory resources beyond edge MCU budgets.
Quantization underpins both of these demonstrations, from the quantized backbone and latent replay buffer of QLR-CL [ 6 ] to the multiplier-free integer arithmetic of Chameleon [ 7 ] , although both confine it to the frozen portion of the network.
The 22-nm accelerator of [ 45 ] extends quantization to the learning path itself, co-designing a sparse update rule with a mixed-precision INT4/INT8 tensor engine that updates only 1 % of the
weights per task, although its consolidation remains an offline, batched process.
CL has also been explored in neuromorphic settings [ 46 , 47 ] , although only on small-scale low-dimensional tasks.
blocks.zh:
基于原型的分类器以eq(3)的affine形式在硬件中被Chameleon加速器演示[7],它学习了Omniglot[42]在线和完全在芯片上的1623手写字符类.
Latent replay是由[6]的量化潜伏重播平台(QLR-CL)在VegaSoC[43]MCU上演示的,这是第一个通过量化潜伏重播缓冲器解决CORe50的重播.
阿加瓦尔等人. [44] 用一个双模系统加以增强,在两个学习时间尺度上运行,一个快速适应内存和一个缓慢的整合,同时部署在FPGA和一个嵌入式图形处理单元(GPU)上.
然而,这两种记忆都通过在设备本身上进行梯度重放而得到整合,因此设备必须随时托管错误反向传播和完全重放缓冲,计算和内存资源超出边缘MCU预算.
量化是上述两种演示的基础,从QLR-CL[6]的量化骨干和潜在重播缓冲,到变色龙[7]的无乘数整数算术,虽然两者都局限于网络的冻结部分.
[45]的22nm加速器将量化扩展至学习路径本身,用混合精度的INT4/INT8拉诺引擎共同设计了一条稀疏的更新规则,只更新1%
每项任务的权重,尽管其合并仍然是一个离线、分批处理的过程。
在神经形态环境中也探索了CL[46,47],虽然只是针对小规模的低维任务.

blocks.en:
Every platform that reaches real-image workloads [ 6 , 44 , 45 ] consolidates offline, in batched processes, whereas fully on-chip online learning has been shown only at Omniglot scale [ 7 ] .
A platform that learns online, fully on-chip, from real-image streams is thus an open challenge.
blocks.zh:
达到真象工作量的每个平台[6,44,45]整合离线,分批进行,而完全的芯片在线学习只显示在Omniglot比例[7].
因此,从真实形象流中学习在线、完全上芯片的平台是一个公开的挑战。

blocks.en: III Dual-Phase CL Framework
blocks.zh: 三级 CL 框架

blocks.en: Novel dual-phase algorithms such as SIESTA [ 13 ] are best understood as a combination of the techniques introduced in Section II-B : the online wake phase is carried out based on cheap architectural CL techniques (i.e. prototype-based learning), while the offline sleep phase relies on higher-footprint rehearsal approaches (i.e. latent replay) for consolidation against catastrophic forgetting. The latter is accompanied by techniques to mitigate the memory overhead, such as PQ. Our proposal is to leverage this dual-phase algorithmic insight into a system framework expanding it with a hardware view, as shown in Fig. 5 , consisting of two main parts.
blocks.zh: 小说双相算法,如SIESTA[13],最好被理解为第二-B节中引入的技术的组合:在线醒悟阶段是在廉价建筑CL技术(即基于原型的学习)的基础上进行的,而离线睡眠阶段则依赖于更高脚印的排练方法(即潜伏的重播)来整合,防止灾难性的遗忘. 后者伴有减轻内存间接费用的技术,如PQ. 如图5所示,我们建议利用这种双相算法洞察力,将其扩展为硬件视图的系统框架,由两个主要部分组成。

blocks.en: Fig. 5: System dual-phase learning framework, consisting of two phases. (a) Wake phase: a frozen feature extractor generates features that are compressed to be used during sleep (ii), and used for online learning (iii) using the running-mean update of Eq. ( 1 ). The wake phase is handled by an MCU minimally extended with a daily sample buffer and prototypical learning. (b) Sleep phase: the online buffer is moved onto a larger buffer and the samples are decoded (iv) and fed to the same embedder and classifier, now trained using standard gradient-based methods (v). The sleep phase is handled via a smart charger, benefiting from extended memory and power budgets.

Its features are used twice: the activations at the latent split are encoded with PQ into a small buffer for consolidation during the next sleep phase (ii), while the embedding drives online learning through the running-mean prototype update of Eq. ( 1 ) (iii). • Hardware – The wake phase can be efficiently supported by an inference accelerator that primarily aims at efficiently executing the backbone feature extractor and embedder. It is minimally extended with an accelerator for prototypical learning and a small on-device buffer for storing, in compressed form, new samples encountered during the day.

Contents from this buffer are then sampled and decoded from PQ (iv). The samples are then used for memory consolidation (v) with latent replay, where gradient-based methods are used to retrain the full network head, including the embedder.
blocks.zh: 算术 - 小型觉醒相缓冲器的内容被转移到整个觉醒/睡眠周期所保持的较大的重播缓冲器. 然后从PQ(四)中取样并解码该缓冲器的内容。 然后用样品进行内存整合(v)进行潜伏重放,其中使用梯度法重新训练整个网络头,包括嵌入器.

blocks.en: Hardware – The sleep phase requires large memory and computational budgets, the former for the replay buffer and the latter for gradient-based learning. A smart charger benefiting from wall-plug power and endowed with extended memory allows fully offloading this overhead from the edge device.
blocks.zh: 硬件 – 睡眠阶段需要大量的内存和计算预算,前者用于重玩缓冲,后者用于梯度学习. 智能充电器从墙插电中受益,并具有延伸内存,能够从边缘设备上完全卸下这一起落架。

blocks.en: The proposed device–charger system allows keeping the edge device within adequate power and memory budgets (mW, MB), while alleviating the accuracy challenges resulting from catastrophic forgetting. Importantly, this system has a key tradeoff between plasticity and memory overhead based on where a baseline neural network is split into a frozen backbone feature extractor and an embedder adapted during sleep. Indeed, a shallower backbone and a deeper embedder will typically increase adaptation capacity during sleep, at the expense of larger replay buffers due to higher sample dimensionality. This choice thus couples the accuracy, the buffer size, and the sleep-phase compute, and is further conditioned on the precision the deployed network is quantized to. This needs to be tackled through adequate hardware/algorithm co-design, which we are carrying out in the next section.
blocks.zh: 拟议的设备充电系统允许将边缘设备保持在足够的功率和内存预算(mW,MB)范围内,同时减轻灾难性遗忘造成的准确性挑战. 重要的是,这个系统在可塑性和内存间接费用之间有着关键的权衡,其基础是将基线神经网络分为一个冷冻骨干特征提取器和一个在睡眠中改造的嵌入器. 实际上,一个更浅的骨干和更深的嵌入器通常会提高睡眠期间的适应能力,而由于样本的维度较高,会牺牲更大的重播缓冲器。 这样,这一选择与精确度、缓冲大小和睡眠阶段计算相配,并进一步以部署的网络的精确度为条件。 这个问题需要通过适当的硬件/数学共同设计来解决,我们正在下一节中进行。

blocks.en: IV System Co-Design
blocks.zh: 四. 系统共同设计

blocks.en: Based on the framework introduced in Section III , we now set the use case and co-design the dual-phase algorithm and the hardware system that executes it, targeting a fully on-device wake phase. The workload and experimental setup are first introduced in Section IV-A , and we then proceed with hardware-aware algorithm exploration (Section IV-B ) and device–charger hardware platform design (Section IV-C ).
blocks.zh: 基于第三节引入的框架,我们现在设定了使用大小写,并共同设计了双相算法以及执行该算法的硬件系统,目标是一个完全在装置上的醒悟阶段。 工作量和实验设置首先在第四节A部分提出,然后我们开始硬件意识算法探索(第四节B部分)和装置充电硬件平台设计(第四节C部分)。

blocks.en: IV-A Use Case and Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-A 使用大小写和实验设置

blocks.en: Targeting a real-world scenario for CL, we adopt the CORe50 benchmark (NICv2-391 protocol), where 50 objects (classes) are recorded across several sessions, i.e. short videos of 300 frames representing distinct environments that vary background, illumination, pose, and occlusion. Of the eleven available sessions for each class, three are held out for testing. 391 batches are then constructed as follows: an initial batch contains 10 class-sessions, which is followed by 390 incremental batches of one class-session each, where a class-session thus contains 300 images. These small, temporally correlated, single-class batches approximate an online, non-iid data stream better than a traditional split dataset scenario, making it a common test for edge CL [ 6 , 44 ] .
blocks.zh: 针对CL的实际情况,我们采用CORe50基准(NICv2-391协议),其中50个对象(类)记录在多个会话中,即300帧的短视频,代表不同的背景、照明、姿势和隔离环境。 每班11个课目中有3个课目进行测试。 391批随后构造如下: 最初的批次包含10个类会,之后是390个递增批次,每批一个类会,因此一个类会包含300个图像. 这些小的、时间上相联的单类批量,与传统的分化数据集情景相比,大约比在线的非二类数据流更好,使其成为边缘CL[6,44]的常见测试.

blocks.en: As the backbone, we adopt MobileNetV3-Large [ 48 ] , shown to be a strong low-footprint backbone for image processing [ 13 ] . Compared to the MobileNetV1 backbone of prior edge-CL platforms [ 6 , 44 ] , where the operator set consists of dense point-wise (PW) and depth-wise (DW) convolutions followed by ReLU, MobileNetV3 adds two operations. The first one is the squeeze-and-excitation (SE) block [ 49 ] , in which two small fully-connected (FC) layers compute a per-channel gate in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] from the spatially averaged feature map and rescale each channel accordingly. The second is the hard-swish activation, x ⋅ hsig ⁡ ( x ) x\cdot\mathrm{hsig}(x) with hsig ⁡ ( x ) = ReLU 6 ​ ( x + 3 ) / 6 \mathrm{hsig}(x)=\mathrm{ReLU_{6}}(x+3)/6 , which replaces ReLU in the deeper layers.
blocks.zh: 作为骨干,我们采用MobileNetV3-Large[48],显示为图像处理的强势低脚印骨干[13]. 与前边缘-CL平台的MobileNetV1主干线[6,44]相比,该操作器集由密集点(PW)和深度点(DW)的演化组成,之后是ReLU,MobileNetV3增加了两个操作. 第一种是挤-引(SE)块[49],其中两个小的全连接(FC)层从空间平均特征图中计算出[0,1][0,1]的每个通道门,并相应调整每个通道的尺度. 其二是硬锯活化,x ⋅ hsig ⁡ (x) x\cdot\ mathrm{hsig} (x) 用hsig ⁡ (x) = ReLU 6 (x + 3) / 6 \ mathrm{hsig} (x) =\ mathrm{ RELU _{ (x + 3)/6,取代深层的 ReLU.

blocks.en: IV-B Hardware-Aware Algorithmic Exploration
blocks.zh: IV-B 硬件-智能算法探索

blocks.en: We are now focusing on the key tradeoff between plasticity and memory overhead, which we outlined at the end of Section III . Given the large search space, we explore this tradeoff in two steps. We will first do an exploration of the split layer without quantization, from which we will narrow down the search to find suitable quantized configurations.
blocks.zh: 我们现在侧重于可塑性和记忆间接费用之间的关键权衡,我们在第三节末尾概述了这一点。 鉴于搜索空间很大,我们分两步探索这种权衡. 我们首先进行一个不量化的分层探索, 从中缩小搜索范围,找到合适的量化配置。

blocks.en: Latent replay split
blocks.zh: 缓冲重放拆分

blocks.en:
Taking our MobileNetV3 network, we will first assess at which layer it is suitable to split it between a frozen feature extraction backbone and a head consisting of an embedder and prototypical classifier (Fig. 5 ), defining it as the latent layer . We thus compare the accuracy–memory–compute tradeoff of the SIESTA and latent replay (LR) algorithms while sweeping the latent layer, as shown in Fig. 6 , from which two main conclusions can be drawn.
First, SIESTA matches or outperforms LR in accuracy at every split, at a lower compute budget.
Second, the latent layer trades accuracy against sleep-phase compute and sample size (Fig. 6 , middle and bottom). Layers 14–16 share the smallest sample footprint, and among them layer 15 gives the highest accuracy. We therefore adopt the latter as the latent layer, since the additional learning compute it entails relative to layer 16 is paid during the sleep phase only, where the charger’s additional energy budget allows affording the compute overhead.
blocks.zh:
我们的移动 净额 V3网络,我们将首先评估在哪个层将其分为一个冷冻的特征提取主干线和一个由嵌入器和原型分类器组成的头(图5),将其定义为潜在的层。 因此,我们比较了SIETA和潜伏重播算法的精确度 — — 模拟度 — — 在扫荡潜伏层的同时进行权衡,如图6所示,可以从中得出两个主要结论。
首先,SIESTA在每分时,在较低的计算预算时,精确度匹配或超过LR.
第二,潜在层与睡眠阶段计算和样本大小(图6、中下层)的精确度进行交易。 14–16层具有最小的样本足迹,其中15层给出的准确度最高. 因此,我们将后者作为潜在的一层,因为相对于第16层的额外学习计算只有在睡眠阶段支付,而充电者的额外能源预算允许支付计算费用。

blocks.en: Keeping the wake phase fully on-chip demands that the backbone, the online buffer, and the prototypes are kept in on-chip memory. We thus quantize the entire wake phase to mixed integer precision, following the uniform affine scheme of Eqs. ( 4 )–( 5 ), and adopt PQ for compressing sample storage requirements.
blocks.zh: 保持觉醒阶段完全在芯片上,要求骨干,在线缓冲,原型保存在芯片内存中. 因此,我们按照Eqs (4) – (5) 的统一affine方案,将整个醒悟阶段量化为混合整数精度,并采用PQ来压缩样本存储要求.

blocks.en: Weight quantization is subject to strict constraints in order to keep all network parameters on-device. For backbone convolutions, we adopt 8-bit weights with per-channel scales, as MobileNet-class networks have been shown to require them based on their point-wise kernel distributions [ 39 ] . The SE FC layers, which account for 51 % of the feature-extractor parameters, are reduced further to 4-bit weights, as FC layers tolerate lower precision than convolutional kernels [ 50 ] . Batch-normalization layers are folded into their preceding convolution weights [ 51 , 38 ] . Under this scheme, the frozen backbone can be reduced to 3.7 MB.
blocks.zh: 重量量化受到严格的限制,以保持所有网络参数在设备上. 对于骨干演化,我们采用每个通道尺度的8位重,因为MobileNet级网络已被证明根据点心内核分布来要求它们[39]. SE FC层占特征提取器参数的51%,由于FC层能容忍比演化内核更低的精度[50],因此被进一步缩减为4位重. 批量常态化层被折叠成它们之前的演化重量[51,38]. 根据这一计划,冷冻的骨干可以减少到3.7 MB.

blocks.en: In order to reduce buffering requirements, the PQ scheme of Section II-B4 can be adopted. Given a sample of spatial dimensions W × H W\times H with C C channels at the chosen latent layer, we treat each spatial location as an independent vector, reshaping the feature map into W ​ H WH vectors of dimension C C . It is then compressed via PQ into W ​ H ⋅ S ⋅ k WH\cdot S\cdot k bits, against the W ​ H ⋅ C ⋅ b WH\cdot C\cdot b bits of its raw form, which for S = 16 S=16 subspaces of k = 8 k=8 bits leads to a 40 × 40\times compression for layer-15 samples (from 31.3 kB to 784 B). We size the replay buffer at 7000 samples (5.48 MB) to stay within the 5.5-MB memory budget of the charger. The PQ centroid sets are fitted on features produced by the quantized backbone offline.
blocks.zh: 为了减少缓冲需求,可以采用第二节-B4的PQ计划. 鉴于空间维度的样本 W × H W\times H 带有 C C 通道的选定潜层,我们把每个空间位置作为独立的矢量处理,将特征图重塑成维度 C 的 W H WH 矢量. 然后通过PQ压缩成W H → S → k WH\cdot S\cdot k比特,相对其原始形态的W H → C → b WH\cdot C\cdot b比特,对于S = 16 S = 16 个子空间的 k = 8 k = 8比特,导致层-15样本压缩40 × 40\时间(从31.3 kB到784 B). 我们以7000个样本(5.48 MB)的重播缓冲器大小,以保持在充电器的5.5-MB内存预算范围内. Based on the parameters above, Table I compares the candidate splits for FP32, INT16, and INT8 activations, each with and without PQ. Activations use one scale and zero-point per tensor, so the requantization factor r r is applied per channel. Prototypes are always kept at 16 bits as the per-sample correction of the running mean of Eq. ( 1 ) shrinks as a class accumulates samples, requiring more headroom. Three observations follow.
First, once the network is quantized, the split between layer 15 and layer 16 matters less accuracy-wise, as the two layers stay within one standard deviation of each other at every precision.
Second, the accuracy is stable from FP32 down to INT16, which differ by at most 0.9 pp, comparable to the standard deviation over runs, and the drop concentrates at INT8, 3.0 pp at layer 15 with PQ, revealing a memory–accuracy tradeoff as INT16 requires a larger scratch memory.
Third, PQ with INT8 centroids costs 0.7 to 2.4 pp across precisions, so the 40 × 40\times buffer compression of Section IV-B does not amplify the quantization loss.

blocks.en: IV-C Dual-Phase Hardware Platform Design
blocks.zh: IV-C 双阶段硬件平台设计

blocks.en: We introduce Hypnos , a hardware platform for dual-phase continual learning, as shown in Fig. 7 . The edge device is a system-on-chip (SoC) built around a RISC-V MCU , embedding • a matrix co-processor to accelerate the dense PW convolutions of the frozen feature extraction backbone, • a compact wake-phase accelerator to handle the low-density operations that neither the scalar core of the MCU nor the matrix co-processor executes efficiently: the DW convolutions, the per-channel requantization of the frozen backbone, the distance and update primitives of the classifier, and PQ encoding.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了Hypnos, 一个两阶段持续学习的硬件平台,如Fig所示。 7 (英语). 边缘装置是一个围绕RISC-V MCU建造的系统对接芯片(SoC),嵌入式——一个矩阵共处理器,以加速冷冻特性提取主干线的密集PW整流,——一个紧凑的醒动相加速器,处理低密度操作,无论是MCU的分级核心还是矩阵共处理器,都无法高效地执行:DW整流,冷冻主干线的每通道重排,分类器的距离和更新原始,以及PQ编码.

blocks.en: This edge device is complemented by a smart charger that hosts the sleep phase. In this section, we outline these main blocks and monitor key design choices.
blocks.zh: 这个边缘设备由一个主持睡眠阶段的智能充电器来补充. 在本节中,我们概述了这些主要块并监测关键的设计选择。

blocks.en: MCU Baseline
blocks.zh: MCU 移动 基线

blocks.en:
In order to build a SoC based on a configurable, open-source RISC-V MCU, we adopt the X-HEEP platform [ 15 ] . We select the CV32E40PX core, extended with the eXtension Interface (XIF) to support custom co-processor integration.
The memory subsystem is organized into four regions: a 64 kB code bank, a 64 kB data bank, a 3.7 MB weight memory holding the network weights as per the quantization outlined in Section IV-B , and a 4 × 8 4\times 8 kB interleaved data bank, the latter enabling the conflict-free parallel access patterns.
The peripheral fabric is built on an NtoM bus interconnect and exposes a minimal set of base peripherals, including a DMA engine, power management, fast interrupt control, and interfaces for communication with the external world such as UART, JTAG, and SPI. Figure 8 (a) shows, for the MCU baseline relying on the scalar core only, a pie-chart breakdown of clock cycles among the key computations done during the wake phase, highlighting that PW and DW convolutions dominate the overall footprint, which will thus be the focus of the next ablations in Fig. 8 (b).
blocks.zh:
为了建立基于可配置,开源的RISC-VMCU的SoC,我们采用了X-HEEP平台[15]. 我们选择了CV32E40PX核心,与eXtension接口(XIF)扩展,支持自定义共处理器集成.
内存子系统被组织成四个区域:一个64 kB代码库,一个64 kB数据库,一个3.7 MB重量内存按照第四节-B部分概述的量化方式持有网络权重,以及一个4×8 4\times 8 kB interleaved Database,后者允许无冲突并行访问模式.
外围布料建在NtoM总线互联上,并暴露出一套最低限度的基底外围,包括一台DMA引擎,动力管理,快速中断控制,以及与UART,JTAG,SPI等外部世界通信的接口. 图8(a)显示,对于只依靠平面板芯的MCU基线,在醒悟阶段进行的关键计算中,对时钟周期进行了饼图细分,突出显示,PW和DW演化在总体足迹中占主导地位,因此,这将是图8(b)中下一个浮标的重点。

blocks.en: Matrix co-processor
blocks.zh: 矩阵共处理器

blocks.en: To tackle the bottleneck of dense, compute-dominant operations, we attach a matrix co-processor via the XIF. For this purpose, we select the Quadrilatero accelerator [ 16 ] for its availability in open source and its streamlined matrix ISA extension in a RISC-V system. Quadrilatero is suitable to accelerate PW convolutions, as they apply a 1 × 1 1\times 1 kernel across the feature map: for each of the H ⋅ W H\cdot W spatial positions, it multiplies the C out × C in C_{\text{out}}\times C_{\text{in}} weight matrix by the C in C_{\text{in}} -dimensional channel vector. Stacking all positions, the layer collapses into a single dense matrix–matrix product of shape ( C out × C in ) × ( C in × H ​ W ) (C_{\text{out}}\times C_{\text{in}})\times(C_{\text{in}}\times HW) . Every weight is then reused across all H ⋅ W H\cdot W positions and every activation across all C out C_{\text{out}} filters. This high data reuse keeps the array’s processing elements saturated. Figure 8 (b) shows that using the matrix co-processor leads to a reduction of cycles needed to execute PW convolutions by 5.7 × 5.7\times over the scalar-core-only MCU baseline.

blocks.en:
The accelerator’s main purpose is two-fold: (i) accelerating vector-heavy operations (e.g., DW convolutions, per-channel requantization) with support for mixed INT4/INT8/INT16 operands, and (ii) ensuring a fully on-chip wake phase, including PQ-related storage for samples encountered during daily operation and held compressed until the next sleep phase.
The accelerator architecture is shown in Fig. 7 and its datapath is shown in Fig. 9 , where DW convolution, requantization, and distance computation can be executed with a common template: a multiply–accumulate body followed by a per-channel post-operation. The PE array ( \raisebox{-0.9pt}{1}⃝ ) has 16 lanes, each multiplying a 16-bit activation word read from the scratch memory ( Act in {}_{\text{in}} ) with a 16-bit weight word ( W in {}_{\text{in}} ) holding a DW kernel, an FC weight, a centroid, or a prototype, depending on the operation.
The mode signal Op sets how a word is read (i.e. one INT16, two INT8, or four INT4 operands), so throughput follows the layer precision, from 16 to 64 multiply–accumulate (MAC) operations per cycle.
Products accumulate into a 48-bit register per lane (i.e. one 48-bit, two 24-bit, or four 12-bit sums), preloaded through Bias in {}_{\text{in}} .
The single post-MAC unit ( \raisebox{-0.9pt}{2}⃝ ), shared by all lanes, realizes the requantization of Eq. ( 5 ).
Figure 8 (b) shows that, compared to the MCU with matrix co-processor, offloading the per-channel requantization to the accelerator reduces the PW cycle count by 1.46 × 1.46\times (from 2.31 G to 1.58 G), and additionally offloading the DW convolutions reduces the DW cycle count by 1.52 × 1.52\times (from 1.84 G to 1.21 G), for a 1.46 × 1.46\times reduction of the full wake phase, from 4.26 G to 2.92 G cycles per sample.

blocks.en: Smart Charger
blocks.zh: 智能充电器

blocks.en:
Since it has access to wall-plug power, the implementation of the smart charger can be simplified to a software-based execution, taking place in three main steps.
First, the daily samples accumulated during the wake phase in the edge device (i.e. PQ codes in their compressed form) are retrieved and added to the replay buffer maintained in the smart charger. The weights of the encoder, as well as the prototypes, are also retrieved for the next step.
Second, gradient-based consolidation retrains the encoder and the head, with samples retrieved from the replay buffer that were reconstructed via PQ decoding.
Third, consolidated parameters are written back to the edge device.
The main constraint for the smart charger is to have access to sufficient memory to store all accumulated samples across wake–sleep phases for the sleep replay buffer, as well as for executing full gradient-based learning on the encoder and head of the network, which here amounts to ∼ 10 {\sim}10 MB in total.
blocks.zh:
由于它拥有墙插电源,智能充电器的实现可以简化为软件执行,分三个主要步骤进行.
首先,在边缘设备(即其压缩形式的PQ代码)的醒悟阶段所积累的日常样本被检索,并添加到智能充电器维护的重播缓冲器中. 编码器的重量以及原型机也被检索到下一步.
第二,基于梯度的合并重排编码器和头部,从通过PQ解码重建的重播缓冲器中提取样本.
第三,综合参数写回边缘设备.
智能充电器的主要制约因素是能够获取足够的内存,将所有累积的样本存储在睡眠重放缓冲器的睡眠阶段,以及在编码器和网络头上进行完全的基于梯度的学习,这里总计为 $ 10 ~sim} 10 MB 。

blocks.en: V Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 五. 实验结果

blocks.en: In this section, we first describe the training and quantization pipelines of the deployed network (Section V-A ) with the CORe50 NICv2-391 [ 37 ] benchmark. Then, we validate the Hypnos device–charger system by prototyping it in a Xilinx ZCU104 FPGA (Section V-B ). Finally, we report the post-synthesis area and power of the edge device implemented in a 28-nm CMOS technology node and compare Hypnos with the state of the art in Section V-C .
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们首先用CORe50 NICv2-391[37]基准描述已部署网络(V-A节)的培训和量化管道。 然后,我们通过在Xilinx ZCU104 FPGA(V-B节)中原型验证Hypnos装置-充电系统。 最后,我们报告在28nm的CMOS技术节点中执行的边缘设备的合成后区和功率,并将Hypnos与V-C节中的先进程度进行比较.

blocks.en: V-A Network Training and Quantization
blocks.zh: V-A 网络培训和量化

blocks.en:
The deployed network is quantized offline to match the integer datapath of Section IV-C .
Starting from a MobileNetV3-Large backbone pretrained on ImageNet, the
network is split into a frozen feature extractor and a plastic head at layer 15, the operating point defined in Section IV-B .
The quantization follows the mixed-precision scheme of Section IV-B , realized in Brevitas [ 53 ] , by combining post-training calibration and fine-tuning.
The scales are calibrated on ImageNet, the head is fine-tuned on the first NICv2-391 batch so that the classifier operates in the quantized
latent space, and a final calibration pass on CORe50 freezes all scales.
The model is then exported as an integer-only firmware bundle (INT8 weights, INT32 biases, per-channel requantization multipliers and zero points, and INT8 PQ centroids fitted through the quantized backbone).
blocks.zh:
已部署的网络被量化为离线,以便与第四至C节的整数数据路径相匹配。
从在ImageNet上预先训练的 MobileNetV3-Large主干线开始,
网络被分成一个冷冻特性提取器和一个塑料头,位于第15层,该操作点在第四节B部分中定义。
数量化遵循了在Brevitas[53]实现的第四-B节混合精度方案,将训练后校准和微调结合起来.
缩放在ImageNet上进行校准,头部在第一个NICv2-391批次上进行微调,以便分类器在整数中运行
潜在的空间,最后的校准 通过CORE50冻结所有尺度。
该型号随后导出为纯整数固件包(INT8权重,INT32偏差,每通道重量化乘数和零点,以及INT8PQ百分点通过整数骨干安装).

blocks.en: V-B FPGA Implementation Results
blocks.zh: 执行结果

blocks.en: For the FPGA validation of the full Hypnos device–charger system, we use a Xilinx ZCU104 board. The edge device (i.e. the X-HEEP RISC-V-based MCU with the Quadrilatero co-processor and the wake-phase accelerator) is prototyped in the programmable logic (PL) in its INT8-activation variant, while a software-based implementation of the smart charger is done in the processing system (PS). The wake phase therefore takes place fully in the PL, while PL–PS (i.e. device–charger) exchanges taking place only during the sleep phase. During the latter, the PYNQ subsystem abstraction is used so that the PS can access PL memories for retrieval and consolidation. The MCU firmware is programmed over JTAG through OpenOCD, the NICv2-391 frames are streamed into the device over SPI, emulating a camera interface, and execution logs are collected over UART.
blocks.zh: 用于FPGA验证全Hypnos设备–充电系统,我们使用Xilinx ZCU104板. 边缘设备(即带有Quadrilatero协处理器和醒相加速器的X-HEEP RISC-V基于MCU)在其INT8激活变体中以可编程逻辑(PL)为原型,而智能充电器的软件执行则在处理系统(PS)中完成. 因此,觉醒阶段完全在PL中进行,而PL-PS(即设备充电器)只在睡眠阶段进行交换。 在后者期间,使用PYNQ子系统抽象,使PS可以访问PL记忆进行检索和整合. MCU固件通过OpenOCD在JTAG上编程,NICv2-391帧在SPI上流入设备,模拟相机接口,执行日志在UART上收集.

blocks.en:
The FPGA implementation fully validates the system with a final accuracy of 78.6% and the number of cycles reported in Fig. 8 . The PL resource utilization numbers are reported in Table II .
The per-block breakdown confirms the minimal wake-phase accelerator premise of Section IV-C : the accelerator occupies 18.8 % of the logic LUTs and 32 DSP blocks, 14.0 % of those used by the design, while the matrix co-processor takes 83.8 % of the DSPs.
The design is instead dominated by memory, with all of the device’s URAM and 98.7 % of its BRAM consumed: the 3.7 MB weight memory fills the 3.4 MB of URAM and spills into BRAM, which further hosts the remaining MCU banks (756 kB in total for the MCU baseline) and the scratch, codebook, prototype, and PQ-code memories of the accelerator (630 kB). This inversion, inexpensive compute and dominant storage, reflects the design goal of the wake phase: keeping the full model state on chip is the cost that enables single-sample online adaptation, not the logic operating on it.

每个区块的分解证实了第四节-C部分最小的醒动相加速器前提:加速器占用了逻辑LUT的18.8%和设计时使用的32个DSP区块,占设计时使用的区块的14.0%,而矩阵共处理器占用了83.8%的DSP.
而设计则以内存为主,所有设备的URAM和98.7%的BRAM消耗:3.7MB重量内存填充了URAM的3.4MB,并溢出到BRAM中,后者进一步托管了剩余的MCU银行(MCU基线共756kB)和刮痕,代码本,原型,以及加速器的PQ码记忆(630kB). 这种倒置,廉价的计算和主导存储,反映了醒悟阶段的设计目标:在芯片上保持完整的模型状态是能够实现单样在线适应的成本,而不是运行在它的逻辑.

blocks.en: V-C Comparison with the State of the Art
blocks.zh: 与艺术状况的比较

blocks.en: To derive power and silicon area estimates, we synthesize the edge device in a 28-nm CMOS technology node. As different configurations lead to different accuracy–footprint tradeoffs (Section III ), we synthesize Hypnos in both INT8- and INT16-activation variants, denoted respectively as A8 and A16. While this requires a larger scratchpad memory for activations (from 384 kB to 743 kB), the logic is otherwise unchanged as the accelerator’s datapath already supports INT16 operands. As Table III shows, the A16 variant thus leads to a higher wake-phase energy per sample (from 0.26 J to 0.35 J at 0.9 V) and area (from 9.43 mm 2 to 10.07 mm 2 ), in exchange for a substantial accuracy boost (from 78.6% to 81.6%).
blocks.zh: 为了获得功率和硅区估计值,我们在28nm的CMOS技术节点中合成了边缘装置. 由于不同的配置会导致不同的精度——脚印权衡(第三节),我们在INT8-和INT16-激活变体中合成Hypnos,分别表示为A8和A16. 虽然这需要更大的抓图内存来激活(从384 kB到743 kB),但逻辑却没有改变,因为加速器的数据路径已经支持INT16操作. 因此,如表三所示,A16变体使每个样品(0.26焦耳到0.35焦耳到0.9焦耳)和面积(9.43毫米2到10.07毫米2)的后相能量提高,以换取实质性的精度提升(从78.6%到81.6%)。

blocks.en: The approach of quantized-latent-replay-based continual learning (QLR-CL) proposed in [ 6 ] is, to the best of our knowledge, the only other work demonstrating CORe50 in a low-power edge device. As that work reports several configurations along the accuracy–footprint tradeoff, Table III includes its two extreme points, both at the highest compression reported (INT8 weights, INT7 latent activations): the accuracy-oriented split at l = 19 l=19 and the latency-oriented split at l = 27 l=27 . Both Hypnos and QLR-CL use the same NICv2-391 protocol for CORe50.

blocks.en:
A learning step is one gradient update of the plastic head on a mini-batch. Over the same stream of training images, QLR-CL updates its head on every incoming batch and performs 2.80 M steps in total, whereas Hypnos consolidates only during sleep and needs 741 k, 3.8 × 3.8\times fewer. Each Hypnos step takes 231 ms on the charger and therefore does not add to the latency experienced during daily operation; spread over the 117 k training images that follow the initial batch, the sleep phase amounts to 1.47 s per sample.
On the device, Hypnos A8 processes a sample in 7.79 s of wake-phase execution, below the 8.4 s of the accuracy-oriented l = 19 l{=}19 configuration, whose latency consists entirely of on-device training. A16 takes 10.54 s ( 1.35 × 1.35\times ), as its INT16 activations halve the number of operands the accelerator’s lanes process per cycle.
The memory footprints explain the fully on-chip row: Hypnos keeps 3.7 MB of weights on chip and confines its 5.48 MB replay buffer to the sleep phase, where the on-chip constraint does not apply. In contrast, QLR-CL at l = 19 l{=}19 streams its 98.3 MB buffer from external memory on every learning step.
In sum, QLR-CL at l = 27 l{=}27 processes samples 107 × 107\times faster than Hypnos A8 but concedes 11.4 pp of accuracy and still relies on external memory, while l = 19 l{=}19 is slightly slower than A8, concedes 3.4 pp, and keeps its buffer off-chip.
Hypnos A8 is the only system that sustains accuracy (78.6 %) while running the wake phase fully on-chip, and A16 raises it further to 81.6 % for the 0.64 mm 2 of additional scratch memory and 1.35 × 1.35\times the wake-phase energy per sample of A8.
This deployment-level result mirrors the algorithmic analysis of Fig. 6 : the dual-phase algorithm outperformed latent replay at every candidate split, and the co-designed platform carries that advantage through to the measured implementation.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en:
In this work, we propose Hypnos, a dual-phase CL platform that confines online adaptation to the edge device and memory consolidation to its charger, fully decoupling it from the cloud during its learning loop.
This is achieved through three key insights: (i) moving the sleep phase to a smart charger benefiting from extended memory and energy budgets, thereby binding the entire system to edge resource constraints, with no cloud-side assumption; (ii) adjusting the memory–accuracy tradeoff by setting the latent split and the activation precision jointly, which trades 3.0 pp of accuracy against 0.64 mm 2 of scratch memory and 1.35 × 1.35\times the wake-phase energy per sample; and (iii) efficiently splitting operations related to the frozen MobileNetV3 backbone, wake-phase adaptation, and PQ encoding into a low-footprint SoC consisting of a RISC-V MCU, a matrix co-processor, and a dedicated accelerator.
The resulting open-source Hypnos platform was deployed on a Xilinx ZCU104 MPSoC, synthesized in a 28-nm technology at 9.43 mm 2 and 33.3 mW (10.07 mm 2 for the INT16-activation variant), and benchmarked on the CORe50 NICv2-391 protocol.
Hypnos A8 reaches 78.6% accuracy at an on-device latency of 7.79 s per sample at 375 MHz, comparable to quantized latent replay at 3.4 pp higher accuracy, with 3.8 × 3.8\times fewer learning steps and 22 × 22\times less learning compute per sample, while A16 reaches 81.6% at 10.54 s per sample. Among the systems compared, it is the only one that learns online and fully on-chip from real-image streams, within edge memory and power budgets and with no server in the loop.
